step1.introSub: Three questions: goal, level, equipment. Then you have a program.
step1.errorBanner: Pick an option in each group.

step2.introSub: Enter your ~1RM for each lift if you know it. Skip it if not — we'll use averages for your level as a starting point.
step2.footnote: All fields in kg · You can always update them later on your profile.

step3.introSub: Injuries, mobility issues or things you'd like to work around. Totally optional.
step3.injuriesPlaceholder: E.g. Slightly strained right shoulder — avoid behind-the-neck press.
step3.footnote: After this, the first session is on Today.
